native_frame_policy.construction: placement_preview_only; CmdBuildLaunchCenter installs a complete facility, no facility construction clock
native_frame_policy.ready: static empty facility; logical frames alias the same selected hardware
native_frame_policy.working: only actual workshop/service/pod work or SpaceTransition preparation/turnaround selects declared equipment parts
native_frame_policy.blocked: static hardware/status from actual native admission/wait reason; no work or queue advancement

source_contract.native_occupant_policy: LaunchOperations workshop/service/pod_workshop/pad_active/pad_queue reference existing paid actors; rocket/probe/pod art stays separate
source_contract.native_inventory_policy: Original station/hub/vehicle CargoPackets only; storage art creates no stock or freight delivery
source_contract.native_water_policy: At least one actual orthogonal navigable Surface water edge; source art fixes no water side and contains no decorative water
source_contract.native_freight_policy: Joined or explicitly linked same-company Surface rail/lorry members retain their own footprints; no baked track, road, vehicle or station extension
